INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Word Processing 2.2 Presentation 2.3 Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Tec, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Word Processing 2.2 Presentation 2.3 Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Tec.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Word Processing 2.2 Presentation 2.3 Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Tec.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Word Processing 2.2 Presentation 2.3 Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Tec.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Word Processing 2.2 Presentation 2.3 Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Tec.

2. When learning Introduction to ICT, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to ICT.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to ICT.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to ICT.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to ICT.

3. When learning Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit.

4. When learning Application Areas of ICT, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Application Areas of ICT.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Application Areas of ICT.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Application Areas of ICT.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Application Areas of ICT.

5. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

6. When learning Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Technologies 3.1 The Internet 3.2 Digita, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Technologies 3.1 The Internet 3.2 Digita.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Technologies 3.1 The Internet 3.2 Digita.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Technologies 3.1 The Internet 3.2 Digita.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Technologies 3.1 The Internet 3.2 Digita.

7. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Monitor
   C. Keyboard
   D. Speaker

8. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Run with the tool

9. When learning Desktop Publishing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Desktop Publishing.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Desktop Publishing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Desktop Publishing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Desktop Publishing.

10. When learning The Internet 3.2 Digital Communication Page 15 of 41 1 STRAND 1.0: ICT AND SOCIE, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for The Internet 3.2 Digital Communication Page 15 of 41 1 STRAND 1.0: ICT AND SOCIE.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for The Internet 3.2 Digital Communication Page 15 of 41 1 STRAND 1.0: ICT AND SOCIE.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after The Internet 3.2 Digital Communication Page 15 of 41 1 STRAND 1.0: ICT AND SOCIE.
   D. Skip safety briefings for The Internet 3.2 Digital Communication Page 15 of 41 1 STRAND 1.0: ICT AND SOCIE.

11. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Ignore burnt cables

12. When learning Word Processing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Word Processing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Word Processing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Word Processing.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Word Processing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain The Internet 3.2 Digital Communication Page 15 of 41 1 STRAND 1.0: ICT AND SOCIE and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain The Internet and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to ICT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Word Processing 2.2 Presentation 2.3 Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Tec.

2. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to ICT.

3. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit.

4. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Application Areas of ICT.

5. C — Information and Communication Technology

6. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Technologies 3.1 The Internet 3.2 Digita.

7. A — CPU

8. C — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

9. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Desktop Publishing.

10. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for The Internet 3.2 Digital Communication Page 15 of 41 1 STRAND 1.0: ICT AND SOCIE.

11. A — Never touch live wires with wet hands

12. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Word Processing.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Internet 3.2 Digital Communication Page 15 of 41 1 STRAND 1.0: ICT AND SOCIE; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Internet; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Introduction to ICT; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
